# Space Grotesk — source

- Font: Space Grotesk, variable weight 300–700, by Florian Karsten and the Space Grotesk Project Authors.
- File: `SpaceGrotesk[wght].ttf` from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/spacegrotesk, downloaded 2026-11-04.
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt` (credited in Config → Sources et licences).

Layout in this project: the font is packaged unchanged as `app/src/main/res/font/space_grotesk.ttf` (V2.22, home
screen). `OFL.txt` and this file are not packaged in the APK.
